title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime's 2nd Season Reveals January Debut, More Cast in 1st Promo Video
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Amara 's The Cat and the Dragon ( Neko to Ryū ) novel series revealed on Friday the show's second season will debut in January 2027 and will air on Tokyo MX , BS NTV , YTV , and AT-X .
author: ANN

title: Inherit the Winds TV Anime Reveals January 10 Debut in Video
content: The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) revealed the show's January 10 debut in a main promotional video on Friday. The video also previews the anime's opening and ending theme songs. The anime will debut on January 19 at 11:30 p.m.
author: ANN

title: 'Neko to Ryuu 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: • The official website for the Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) television anime revealed additional cast, opening theme song, and the first promotional video for the Season 2 on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Odekake Kozame Gets 1st Stop-Motion Short
content: Kadokawa unveiled the first stop-motion short for Penguin Box 's Odekake Kozame ( Little Shark's Day Out ) manga on Friday. The short, titled "Doughnut," shows Kozame-chan finding a doughnut on top of a table. The manga and its anime adaptations follow the nostalgic everyday adventures of a young shark.
author: ANN

title: Monogatari Off & Monster Season Anime's New Episode Airs on December 31
content: Aniplex announced on Friday the " Wazamonogatari : Karen Ogre" episode of the MONOGATARI Series: OFF & MONSTER Season anime will air on December 31. The staff also revealed a new key visual and a promotional video. Mulasaki Ima performs the episode's theme song "Shelter." The above video previews the song.
author: ANN

title: Solitary Gourmet Live-Action Series Gets 10th Straight New Year's Eve Special
content: TV Tokyo announced on Thursday that the live-action series of Masayuki Kusumi and Jiro Taniguchi 's Kodoku no Gourmet ( Solitary Gourmet ) manga will have its 10th consecutive New Year's special, tentatively titled Kodoku no Gourmet 2026 Ōmisoka Special . The special will air on December 31 starting at 10:00 p.m. JST.
author: ANN

title: Additional Cast for 'Shuiro no Kamen' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's Shuiro no Kamen ( The Vermilion Mask ) manga announced five additional cast members on Friday. The anime series began airing on October 10 at 5:30 p.m. on Yomiuri TV and Nippon TV, with the second part will air in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Hinagiku no Jinsei' Announces Additional Staff, 2027 Delays
content: Animation studio ame pippin revealed additional staff members and still images (pictured) for the anime movie adaptation of Banana Yoshimoto 's Hinagiku no Jinsei ( Daisy's Life ) novel on Friday. The anime, previously scheduled for 2026, is now planned for a 2027 opening.
author: MyAnimeList

title: A Fantasy Epic Just Confirmed Its 2027 Launch & Anime Fans Should Take Notice
content: A new anime just confirmed its 2027 release window, and action fantasy fans must add it to their watchlist. 2026 is almost finally its end, which is why the next year’s lineup is revealing all the major information fans can expect.
